Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.totp

Record Class TotpCredential

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.totp.TotpCredential
Record Components:
userId - identifier of the user the credential belongs to.
encryptedSecret - the secret, encrypted at rest; copied on the way in and on the way out.
confirmed - whether the user proved possession by entering a first valid code.
lastUsedStep - time step of the last accepted code, or NEVER_USED; later codes must be newer.
createdAt - instant at which the credential was created.
public record TotpCredential(UUID userId, byte[] encryptedSecret, boolean confirmed, long lastUsedStep, Instant createdAt) extends Record
The TOTP credential of one user. The secret is only ever held encrypted.
